GMM Pfaudler delivered a mixed but fundamentally weak Q1 FY27 against
expectations. On the surface, Revenue grew a Solid 16.3% YoY to %924.76 Cr, beating

costs (from %42.91 Cr to 322.73 Cr), which included %6.77 Cr of non-core forex
restatement gains. Operationally, this is a clear miss on profitability.

Mumbai, India - August 6, 2026: Swiggy Limited (NSE: SWIGGY, BSE: 544285), India’s
pioneering on-demand convenience platform, today outlined its FY31 vision at Capital Markets
Day 2026, setting out its goal to build a 210,000 Cr. Adjusted EBITDA business, more than tripling
consolidated Gross Order Value (GOV) to approximately 22.5 Lakh Cr. from 267,734 Cr. in FY26,
implying a 30%+ GOV CAGR through 2031 alongside expanding profitability.
Commenting on Swiggy’s vision, Sriharsha Majety, Managing Director and Group CEO,
Swiggy, said, “Our confidence in achieving our five-year EBITDA goal is rooted in the strength of
our fundamentals. We have always believed that if we stay focused on solving large consumer
problems and execute with discipline , the financial outcomes will follow. We are operating in
three of India’s largest and fastest growing consumer opportunity spaces , food-delivery, quick
commerce and out of home consumption with each of these businesses having the potential to
compound over the coming years”.

RATE GAIN - One off Quarter
Entire quarter gain was due to FIFA World Cup
Overall numbers boosted by this one off event
RateGain
Revenue Nearly Triples to INR 785 Cr (+188% YoY); Adjusted EBITDA at Almost 4x, up 289% to INR 193 Cr
India, 06 August 2026: RateGain Travel Technologies Limited (NSE: RATEGAIN, BSE: 543417), a global leader
in Al-powered SaaS solutions for the travel and hospitality industry, today announced its financial results for
QI FY2027 ended June 30, 2026. The company reported operating revenue of INR 785.0 Cr, up 187.6% Y-o-Y,
with an Adjusted EBITDA margin of 24.6%, marking its highest-ever quarterly EBITDA. The Adjusted PAT grew
by 148.8% Y-o-Y to INR 116.8 Cr in QIFY27. The quarter was driven by strong travel demand during the FIFA
World Cup and a record quarter for new business in Asia-Pacific, alongside continued momentum on the
integration of Sojern, expanding Al-powered digital marketing capabilities across the business.
Travel demand held firm through the quarter across the US, Europe, and Asia-Pacific, even as a recovery in
the Middle East has yet to take hold. In the US specifically, the FIFA World Cup gave a direct lift to travel activity.
RateGain's Destinations business benefited directly, as destination marketing organizations expanded co-op
marketing programs and jointly funded campaigns run with travel partners to attract visitors around the
tournament. Steady booking activity across these markets enabled RateGain's customers to respond quickly
to shifting demand while generating more transactions and intent signals across the platform.
The Asia-Pacific business delivered its strongest-ever quarter, led by record new property sign-ups on the
Sojern platform and continued momentum in new bookings and client engagement. Sustained investment in
the region is paying off and reinforces RateGain’s strategy of deepening its presence in high-growth
geographies.
Building on the first phase of its Sojern integration, the company’s focus for FY27 is to accelerate this go-to-
market motion and capitalize on the opportunity in front of it, including a significant cross-sell opportunity
across its combined customer base and geographic expansion. RateGain also continues to deepen data
partnerships with leading travel brands, extending the reach of its travel-intent data.

RESULTS CONTEXT TRENT
vane
Growth agenda (contd,):
Our store portfolio has evolved over time and remains significantly heterogenous in various respects. We continue to add stores within select
existing catchments across Tier | and Tier II cities, even as we accelerate presence in multiple smaller markets in the current phase of network
expansion. In the case of Zudio, in the current quarter, over 80% of new stores were opened in Tier I, Ill cities and in peripheral new growth
micro-markets. The intent is to grow our presence in both existing as well as new micro-markets/ geographies and to position ourselves
favourably as more regions register stronger economic growth. The agenda is to pursue growing reach and share of revenues as we selectively
increase the density of our presence across key markets with an improving customer proposition.
The foregoing approach of greater presence in select clusters coupled with better customer proposition is delivering encouraging outcomes
from a revenue density as well as profitability perspective. Further, we believe the newer markets that we are now entering, afford substantial
growth opportunities, and yet, will mature over time in terms of adoption of fashion trends and density of consumption. Hence, the revenue
profile and the growth trajectory of newer stores are not entirely comparable with that of the existing portfolio, Our experience indicates that
newer markets tend to mature over a two-to-three year period.
Given the business model choices and the intent to drive the share of revenues in proximate markets, we are primarily seeking to pursue
revenue growth across comparative micto-markets vis-d-vis just the performance of comparative stores. In managing our store network, we are
consistently seeking to optimize the quality of brand presence in micro-markets and the economic attractiveness of the portfolio in terms of
profitability, return on committed capital & operating cashflows.
27 was in the tow single digits. The emerging categories, including beauty & personal care,
innerwear and footwear contributed over 21% of our revenues. Westside online together with our proposition on the Tata Neu platform
continues to witness traction and grow profitably. In Q1FY27, online revenues contributed to over 6% of Westside revenues.

Day Trader Telugu · 04:13
If Cohance Lifesciences successfully executes these milestones, the company's financial profile
will experience a stark turnaround from its depressed Q1 FY2027 state.
Revenue Trajectory and Mix
Meeting the guidance means overcoming the 23% consolidated revenue decline seen in Q1 to
finish the year with strong growth momentum. In the near term, H2 FY2027 would see top-line
expansion fueled by scheduled commercial program deliveries, the execution of commercial
restocking orders, and new product qualifications. Over the next three to four years, the
revenue mix would shift favorably as the high-growth nucleic acid and ADC segments expand
rapidly, while the established API Plus and Specialty Chemicals segments compound at steady
double-digit rates. DOCK +2
Margin Expansion and Operating Leverage
If the top-line recovery materializes as projected, operating leverage will act as a major catalyst
for profitability. In Q1 FY2027, the consolidated adjusted EBITDA margin dropped to just 2.2%
due to negative operating leverage and subsidiary consolidation impacts (notably NJ Bio).
Reaching management's targets means returning to full-year margins that resemble the
previous year, followed by steady, compounding margin expansion from FY2028 onwards.
Additionally, generating higher revenue conversion and capacity utilization across the small
molecule and ADC networks will progressively amortize currently elevated cost bases, driving
stronger bottom-line results. pocx+3

RATE GAIN - One off Quarter
Entire quarter gain was due to FIFA World Cup
Overall numbers boosted by this one off event
RateGain
Revenue Nearly Triples to INR 785 Cr (+188% YoY); Adjusted EBITDA at Almost 4x, up 289% to INR 193 Cr
India, 06 August 2026: RateGain Travel Technologies Limited (NSE: RATEGAIN, BSE: 543417), a global leader
in Al-powered SaaS solutions for the travel and hospitality industry, today announced its financial results for
QI FY2027 ended June 30, 2026. The company reported operating revenue of INR 785.0 Cr, up 187.6% Y-o-Y,
with an Adjusted EBITDA margin of 24.6%, marking its highest-ever quarterly EBITDA. The Adjusted PAT grew
by 148.8% Y-o-Y to INR 116.8 Cr in QIFY27. The quarter was driven by strong travel demand during the FIFA
World Cup and a record quarter for new business in Asia-Pacific, alongside continued momentum on the
integration of Sojern, expanding Al-powered digital marketing capabilities across the business.
Travel demand held firm through the quarter across the US, Europe, and Asia-Pacific, even as a recovery in
the Middle East has yet to take hold. In the US specifically, the FIFA World Cup gave a direct lift to travel activity.
RateGain's Destinations business benefited directly, as destination marketing organizations expanded co-op
marketing programs and jointly funded campaigns run with travel partners to attract visitors around the
tournament. Steady booking activity across these markets enabled RateGain's customers to respond quickly
to shifting demand while generating more transactions and intent signals across the platform.
The Asia-Pacific business delivered its strongest-ever quarter, led by record new property sign-ups on the
Sojern platform and continued momentum in new bookings and client engagement. Sustained investment in
the region is paying off and reinforces RateGain’s strategy of deepening its presence in high-growth
geographies.
Building on the first phase of its Sojern integration, the company’s focus for FY27 is to accelerate this go-to-
market motion and capitalize on the opportunity in front of it, including a significant cross-sell opportunity
across its combined customer base and geographic expansion. RateGain also continues to deepen data
partnerships with leading travel brands, extending the reach of its travel-intent data.

consolidated Gross Order Value (GOV) to approximately 22.5 Lakh Cr. from 267,734 Cr. in FY26,
implying a 30%+ GOV CAGR through 2031 alongside expanding profitability.

Swiggy, said, “Our confidence in achieving our five-year EBITDA goal is rooted in the strength of

problems and execute with discipline , the financial outcomes will follow. We are operating in
three of India’s largest and fastest growing consumer opportunity spaces , food-delivery, quick
commerce and out of home consumption with each of these businesses having the potential to
compound over the coming years”.

GMM Pfaudler delivered a mixed but fundamentally weak Q1 FY27 against
expectations. On the surface, Revenue grew a Solid 16.3% YoY to %924.76 Cr, beating
the 10-15% estimate, and Net Profit (attributable to owners) more than doubled YoY to

strong PAT growth was heavily distorted by a massive YoY drop in reported finance
costs (from %42.91 Cr to 322.73 Cr), which included %6.77 Cr of non-core forex
restatement gains. Operationally, this is a clear miss on profitability.

Part 3: Industrials & Manufacturing
1. Aegis Vopak Term (AEGISVOPAK) Pulse: OK — Sentiment: Mixed

Sentiment: Mixed
« Market Reality: After-hours release: Neuland Labs. delivered mixed financial
execution supported by core business operations (Gland Pharma partnered with
Neuland Laboratories for a sterile AP] manufacturing suite; Infosys expanded its
Al-led IT transformation with Metsa Group; and Sterlite Technologies secured a
$210 million long-term optical fibre cable agreement.).
Sentiment: Mixed
¢ Market Reality: After-hours release: Tenneco Clean Air India recorded mixed Q1
results as automotive clean-air input cost inflation contracted EBITDA margins by
182 bps, despite revenue expanding 18.5% YoY to Rs 154 Cr.

Sentiment: Positive

Sentiment: Mixed

1. Aptech (APTECHT) Pulse: Good
Sentiment: Mixed
« Market Reality: During-hours release: Aptech shares slipped 0.0% on mixed

stood at 6.77% (vs 6.07% YoY).).
2. Blue Pearl Agri (BPAGRI) Pulse: OK Sentiment: Mixed
« Market Reality: During-hours release: Blue Pearl Agriculture shares closed down

operations (PAT Rs 1.2 Cr on revenue of Rs 24 Cr).
3. Ent.Network (ENIL) Pulse: OK — Sentiment: Mixed
« Market Reality: After-hours release: Entertainment Network India posted mixed
Qi results due to mute radio advertisement volume growth and elevated non-
operating overheads, with net profit slipping to Rs 2.1 Cr.
4. Shankara Building (SHANKARA) Pulse: Weak
Sentiment: Positive

© Forward Signals
CAPEX
Commissioned 250k capacity at Kharkhoda (May) and 250k at Hansalpur (July),
increasing total capacity to 2.9 million units.
PRICING COSTS
Temporary hit from shifting to monthly commodity settlement cycle; expects to
revert to quarterly lag, unlocking benefits in Q2 and Q3.
PRICING COSTS
Calibrated two-step price increases taken in June (50 bps) and August; majority of
benefits will flow into Q2.
@ The Verdict
While Q1 EBITDA margins missed expectations at 8.2%, management clarified in the
concall that 110 bps of the hit was due to a temporary shift to a monthly commodity
settlement cycle amid the West Asia conflict. This is expected to reverse in Q2/Q3.
Meanwhile, the company successfully added 500k new capacity at Kharkhoda and
Hansalpur to address supply constraints, while calibrated price hikes in June and
August will further support upcoming quarters. Demand remains robust, with the new
Brezza seeing 2,000 bookings a day.

Market Sentiment for August 5 Reportings
Part 5: Broader Market Movers
1. Whirlpool India (WHIRLPOOL) Pulse: Weak
Sentiment: Negative
« Market Reality: During-hours release: Whirlpool India shares slipped 2.0% on
weak operational performance and profit taking (Whirlpool of India's Q1 EBITDA
declined 34% to 140 crore, with EBITDA margins narrowing to 5% from 8.7%,
leading to a 5% fall in its stock.).
2. Time Technoplast (TIMETECHNO) Pulse: OK — Sentiment: Positive
« Market Reality: After-hours release: Time Technoplast achieved robust Q1
operational growth driven by a 29.3% demand surge in composite CNG cylinders
and proactive Rs 89.7 Cr net debt reduction (PAT +23.9% YoY to Rs 117.9 Cr).
3. Pearl Global Ind (PGIL) Pulse: Great
Sentiment: Positive
« Market Reality: After-hours release: Pearl Global Industries achieved robust Q1
execution driven by apparel export margin expansion (+157 bps to 10.72%) and
shareholder value creation via a 1:1 bonus share issue (PAT +47.5% YoY to Rs
100 Cr).
4. GNF C (GNFC) Pulse: Weak
Sentiment: Mixed
« Market Reality: After-hours release: G N F C delivered mixed financial execution
supported by core business operations (GNFC's Q1 consolidated net profit
increased to 312 crore, up from 83 crore YoY, with revenue rising 39.8% to
2,238 crore and EBITDA at 393 crore.).
5. Garware Tech. (GARFIBRES) Pulse: Weak
Sentiment: Mixed
« Market Reality: After-hours release: Garware Tech. delivered mixed financial
execution supported by core business operations (Garware Technical Fibres
reported a Q1 consolidated net profit of 645 million, up from 530.9 million YoY,
with revenue increasing to 4.82 billion from 3.67 billion YoY. Q1 EBITDA rose to
901 million from 681 million YoY, and EBITDA margin improved to 18.68% from
18.55% YoY.).
